items.title: Polymarket faced $10 million fraud attempt as its CEO pushed growth over compliance concerns: WSJ
items.summary: In a separate attack, hackers compromised nearly 500 users' accounts using stolen personal information, according to the report.

items.title: Visa Moves to Close Meme Coin Credit Card Rewards Loophole
items.summary: After banks lost their push for tighter stablecoin rules in the failed Clarity Act, JP Morgan scored a narrower win as Visa moves to stop meme coin purchases from being coded as ordinary "digital media" and earning card rewards.

items.title: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
items.summary: The crypto platform’s market value has fallen to about $753 million, putting fresh attention on the licenses, custody infrastructure and customer relationships a buyer could inherit.

items.title: Trump says US will form ‘AI Force’ and appoint AI czar: Reports
items.summary: Trump posted on Truth Social that his new project would manage the fast-growing sector without adding regulations that could slow innovation.
